name: Farm Fresh Berhad
overview: 2026年，Farm Fresh Berhad 的公告主要涉及股本集资、股票上市及股息派发，未披露具体业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或合约信息。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比增长17.6%，净利润同比下降18.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, Farm Fresh Berhad's announcements mainly involved equity fund raising, share listings and dividend payment, with no specific information disclosed on expansion, new business, reduction or contracts of business segments. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue increased 17.6% year-on-year, while net profit decreased 18.2% year-on-year.
